title: "Leadership & Committees"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| results: asis
library(knitr)
source("scripts/shared.R")

senators <- load_senators()
ns       <- senator_name_sets(senators)
votes    <- load_all_votes(ns)
bills    <- load_bills() |> bill_statuses(votes)

# One tab per committee, plus the Floor. Each tab shows the membership,
# every agenda filed for it, and the most recent votes taken. (Which
# bills sit in which committee is the Bills page's Committee column.)
sync_intake_agendas()
agenda_files <- list.files(AGENDAS_DIR, pattern = "\\.pdf$")

# --- Leadership at a glance -------------------------------------------------
# Everyone who runs something, in one place: the party leadership, then
# each committee's chair and vice chair. Both come from the Committee
# Assignments & Leadership form (via load_senators()).
senator_link <- function(d) {
  if (length(d) == 0 || is.na(d[1])) return("—")
  s <- senators[senators$District == d[1], ]
  sprintf("[%s](%s/district_%s.html) (%s)", s$Name, SENATOR_PAGES_DIR, s$District, s$Party)
}
lead_roles <- c("Pro Tem", "Majority Leader", "Majority Whip",
                "Minority Leader", "Minority Whip", "Minority Deputy Whip")
party_tbl <- data.frame(
  Role    = lead_roles,
  Senator = vapply(lead_roles, function(r)
    senator_link(senators$District[!is.na(senators$Leadership) & senators$Leadership == r]),
    character(1)),
  row.names = NULL
)
policy <- setdiff(names(COMMITTEE_NAMES), "floor")
chair_tbl <- data.frame(
  Committee    = unname(COMMITTEE_NAMES[policy]),
  Chair        = vapply(policy, function(c)
    senator_link(senators$District[!is.na(senators$Chair) & senators$Chair == c]), character(1)),
  `Vice Chair` = vapply(policy, function(c)
    senator_link(senators$District[!is.na(senators$Vice.Chair) & senators$Vice.Chair == c]), character(1)),
  check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL
)

cat("## Leadership\n\n")
if (all(party_tbl$Senator == "—") && all(chair_tbl$Chair == "—") &&
    all(chair_tbl$`Vice Chair` == "—")) {
  cat("*Leadership and committee chairs have not been chosen yet.*\n\n")
} else {
  cat("::: {.grid}\n\n::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-5}\n\n")
  cat(kable(party_tbl, format = "pipe"), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n:::\n\n::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-7}\n\n")
  cat(kable(chair_tbl, format = "pipe"), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n:::\n\n:::\n\n")
}

cat("## Committees\n\n")
cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")

for (code in names(COMMITTEE_NAMES)) {
  cat("##", COMMITTEE_NAMES[code], "\n\n")

  # --- Membership (not applicable to the Floor) ---------------------------
  if (code != "floor") {
    members <- senators |>
      filter(grepl(code, Committee)) |>
      mutate(
        Role = case_when(
          !is.na(Chair) & Chair == code ~ "Chair",
          !is.na(Vice.Chair) & Vice.Chair == code ~ "Vice Chair",
          TRUE ~ "Member"
        ),
        Senator = sprintf("[%s](%s/district_%s.html)", Name, SENATOR_PAGES_DIR, District)
      ) |>
      arrange(factor(Role, levels = c("Chair", "Vice Chair", "Member")), Last.Name) |>
      select(Senator, Role, Party, District)

    if (nrow(members) > 0) {
      cat(kable(members, format = "pipe"), sep = "\n")
      cat("\n\n")
    } else {
      cat("*Committee assignments have not been made yet.*\n\n")
    }
  }

  # --- Agendas: every one filed for this body, newest first ----------------
  mine <- agenda_files[startsWith(agenda_files, paste0(code, "_"))]
  mine <- mine[!grepl("_prev", mine)]        # superseded revisions stay in Drive only
  cat("### Agendas\n\n")
  if (length(mine) > 0) {
    # Filenames sort by name, not date; parse the date to order them
    dates <- as.Date(gsub("^[a-z]+_(\\d+)_(\\d+)_(\\d+)\\.pdf$", "20\\3-\\1-\\2", mine))
    ord <- order(dates, decreasing = TRUE)
    cat(sprintf("- [%s](%s/%s)\n", format(dates[ord], "%A, %B %d, %Y"),
                AGENDAS_DIR, mine[ord]), sep = "")
    cat("\n")
  } else {
    cat("*No agendas filed yet.*\n\n")
  }

  # --- Recent votes --------------------------------------------------------
  if (!is.null(votes[[code]])) {
    recent <- votes[[code]] |>
      arrange(desc(Date)) |>
      head(5) |>
      left_join(bills |> select(bill_measure, url_slug), by = c("Bill" = "bill_measure")) |>
      mutate(Bill = ifelse(is.na(url_slug), Bill,
                           sprintf("[%s](%s/%s.html)", Bill, BILL_PAGES_DIR, url_slug)),
             Date = format(Date, "%b %d")) |>
      select(Date, Bill, Vote, Result)
    cat("### Recent votes\n\n")
    cat(kable(recent, format = "pipe"), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}

cat(":::\n")
```
